verdict.rationale: Evidence only states aggregate DGX system memory (8x B200 GPUs = 1,440 GB total GPU memory), implying ~180GB per GPU, but no explicit per-GPU memory type (e.g., HBM3e), bus width, or per-GPU bandwidth figures are given in the evidence pack. NVLink bandwidth cited is switch fabric aggregate, not GPU memory bandwidth. missing for 10: explicit memory type designation, bus width in bits, per-GPU memory bandwidth in TB/s, and confirmation these apply specifically to the B200 die rather than the DGX system aggregate.
